bio.text: Will Johanson is the Libertarian candidate for Idaho's 2nd Congressional District in 2026, according to his campaign website.

According to his campaign website, he was born and raised in California's Central Valley and served in the U.S. Navy as a nuclear operator, including aboard the USS Georgia, separating in 2020 as a Machinist's Mate (Nuclear) First Class.

His website says he earned bachelor's and master's degrees in materials science and engineering at Boise State University using the GI Bill, and now works as an engineer in Idaho's semiconductor industry.
